note: Evidence that cannot be produced from inside the repository. Each key is satisfied only by a matching, unexpired record in governance/APPROVALS.json signed by the named role. audit.py keeps any C-ID that needs an unsatisfied key at PARTIAL (repo work complete, external evidence pending); gate.py reports it BLOCKED.

arch-review.what: Peer review + approval of docs/architecture/* by architecture, runtime, SRE and security; tabletop of one violated assumption

owner-assignment.what: Named, active owners/on-call/security/release roles in OWNERS.yaml (no UNASSIGNED) and a validated escalation path

wadm-pin.what: Wadm release + digest selected and recorded in pins.json with approved=true

wadm-live.what: Integration run of tests against a live pinned Wadm + wasmCloud lattice (WadmAdapter transport), results attached

perf-approval.what: perf/thresholds.json re-baselined and approved on reference hardware

edge-hardware.what: Power/thermal measurements per perf/EDGE_POWER_PLAN.md on constrained edge nodes

multi-arch-ci.what: CI matrix green on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (and any other supported arch)

fleet-scale.what: Fleet-scale / soak run (>=24h, >=1000 hosts simulated or real) with results

security-review.what: Threat model reviewed and accepted by security

node-attestation.what: Node identity/attestation mechanism (e.g. TPM / SPIFFE) selected and integrated at the transport

kms.what: Data/token keys sourced from a managed KMS with scheduled rotation evidence

external-anchor.what: Journal head periodically anchored to an external append-only store

consensus-lease.what: Multi-node leader lease backed by a consensus store (file epoch fencing is single-host only)

game-day.what: Game day exercising canary, rollback, emergency disable, backup/restore, incident runbooks with evidence

review-records.what: Completed recurring review records in governance/REVIEWS.json, none overdue

signing-key.what: Gate signing key provisioned (INV63_GATE_SIGNING_KEY) and its public key registered

pk_core.what: pk_core inventory framework pinned and installed; tests/test_component.py executed (not skipped)

revision-signoff.what: Sign-off of this exact revision (record.revision == source digest): reviewers and approval date for every design artifact under docs/, ops/, governance/
